official_source_policy: Every selected, candidate, and hold row links to a primary publisher source rechecked on the execution date; the manifest is reviewed evidence, never a network-time latest claim.

xcode.compatibility_reason: Xcode changes SwiftPM/CocoaPods resolution, linker inputs, and signing; the encrypted iOS lane is currently proven only with Xcode 26.2 and the SQLCipher Pod linker strip.
xcode.exit_condition: Phase 60 accepts Xcode 26.6 only after clean SwiftPM plus SQLCipher-only CocoaPods debug/profile/release builds and encrypted open/reopen, migration, and backup evidence without system SQLite fallback.

jdk.compatibility_reason: JDK 17 is the AGP-supported baseline and must stay synchronized with AGP and Gradle; changing the runtime alone would create an unreviewed Android host combination.
jdk.exit_condition: Phase 61 records JDK 17 against the final all-or-hold AGP/Gradle lane and proves a non-debug-signed release plus supported-emulator journeys with Android minSdk 24 intact.

gradle.compatibility_reason: Gradle 9.1 is coupled to AGP 9 and the Kotlin/DSL migration; upgrading the wrapper independently would leave a partially modernized Android build lane.
gradle.exit_condition: Phase 61 moves to Gradle 9.1 only with the complete AGP 9/Kotlin/DSL migration, green debug and non-debug-signed release builds, and emulator evidence while preserving Android minSdk 24.

agp.compatibility_reason: AGP 9 introduces built-in Kotlin and DSL changes that affect the app and plugin graph, so it cannot be selected while legacy KGP or Flutter opt-outs remain.
agp.exit_condition: Phase 61 selects AGP 9.0.1 only after built-in Kotlin/new DSL adoption and legacy KGP/temporary opt-out cleanup are complete, with signed release and supported-emulator evidence at Android minSdk 24.

flutter_riverpod.compatibility_reason: The Riverpod runtime must move with annotation, generator, lint, and analyzer packages because provider APIs and generated contracts span the whole lane.
flutter_riverpod.exit_condition: Phase 58 resolves one stable Riverpod runtime/annotation/generator/lint graph, regenerates outputs, and passes architecture, custom-lint, analyzer, and full test gates without overrides.

riverpod_annotation.compatibility_reason: Although the reviewed candidate matches the resolved version, annotation metadata is held with the Riverpod generator/runtime cohort to prevent a split generated-code contract.
riverpod_annotation.exit_condition: Phase 58 reaffirms or changes riverpod_annotation only as part of the single stable Riverpod graph after clean regeneration and lint/architecture/full-suite verification.

json_annotation.compatibility_reason: The annotation API is paired with json_serializable and the analyzer/code-generation graph; changing or reselecting it independently could invalidate generated serialization code.
json_annotation.exit_condition: Phase 58 selects json_annotation with json_serializable in the coherent analyzer/codegen graph, regenerates from clean state, and confirms no unexpected generated diff or test regression.

speech_to_text.compatibility_reason: Version 7.4.0 changes the adapter/test API and native speech symbols used by the trilingual voice-entry and privacy-fallback paths, so resolution alone is insufficient evidence.
speech_to_text.exit_condition: Phase 59 accepts 7.4.0 only after clean Android/iOS native builds and Japanese, Chinese, and English permission, recognition, cancellation, error, and fallback behavior pass.

file_picker.compatibility_reason: The current native picker behavior is part of the atomic file/share cohort and the single-file .hpb restore path; a version match does not replace platform acceptance evidence.
file_picker.exit_condition: Phase 59 reaffirms or upgrades file_picker only after clean native builds and successful .hpb selection, cancellation, import, and restore behavior on the supported platforms.

share_plus.compatibility_reason: Backup and family-invite flows depend on native share-sheet file/URI handling, so share_plus is held with the file/package-info native cohort until behavior is exercised.
share_plus.exit_condition: Phase 59 reaffirms or upgrades share_plus only after clean native builds and supported system-share flows successfully present and share backup and invite payloads.

package_info_plus.compatibility_reason: Package identity/version lookup is platform-backed and participates in the file/share/package-info cohort and release performance evidence, so it is not changed independently.
package_info_plus.exit_condition: Phase 59 reaffirms or upgrades package_info_plus with the native plugin cohort after clean builds and correct application identity/version lookup on supported platforms.

flutter_local_notifications.compatibility_reason: Local notification initialization and tap routing share native lifecycle behavior with Firebase Messaging; selecting one plugin without the cohort can break cold-start delivery paths.
flutter_local_notifications.exit_condition: Phase 59 reaffirms or upgrades the notification plugin only after coordinated Firebase registration, foreground/background routing, cold-start tap, and signed APNs/FCM evidence.

sqlcipher_flutter_libs.compatibility_reason: Version 0.7.0+eol ships no native SQLCipher library; 0.6.8 is the last functional package line in the proven encrypted sqlite3 2.x path.
sqlcipher_flutter_libs.exit_condition: Phase 60 permits replacement only after a coordinated native graph proves non-empty cipher_version, encrypted reopen, released-schema migration, and backup restore on iOS and Android without plaintext/system SQLite fallback.

sqlite3.compatibility_reason: sqlite3 3.x is not compatible with the current sqlcipher_flutter_libs 0.6.8 native integration and cannot be upgraded separately without risking plaintext/system SQLite resolution.
sqlite3.exit_condition: Phase 60 accepts sqlite3 3.x only with an approved SQLCipher-native replacement and passing cipher identity, open/reopen, migration, backup, simulator, and device build evidence.

lucide_icons_flutter.compatibility_reason: The reviewed local fork preserves the package API while bundling only the static font and 37 used codepoints, avoiding upstream's six unused variable-weight font assets.
lucide_icons_flutter.exit_condition: Phase 59 replaces or refreshes the fork only after upstream source/license and every LucideIcons reference are reviewed and static-subset plus release tree-shaken asset checks remain green.

json_serializable.compatibility_reason: json_serializable consumes analyzer and json_annotation APIs and rewrites tracked model output, so it must be selected with the complete analyzer/code-generation graph.
json_serializable.exit_condition: Phase 58 reaffirms or upgrades json_serializable with its annotation/analyzer peers, then completes clean generation with no unexpected tracked diff and passes serialization tests.

riverpod_generator.compatibility_reason: The generator emits provider names and lifecycle code consumed by Riverpod runtime and lint rules; an isolated change would split generated output from its runtime contract.
riverpod_generator.exit_condition: Phase 58 selects riverpod_generator only in the coherent runtime/annotation/lint/analyzer graph, regenerates from clean state, and passes provider, architecture, lint, and full-suite gates.

custom_lint.compatibility_reason: custom_lint depends on analyzer plugin APIs used by Riverpod lint and the project import-boundary guard, so a partial analyzer/lint move could silently weaken enforcement.
custom_lint.exit_condition: Phase 58 selects custom_lint with the analyzer and lint cohort only after both valid code passes and deliberately invalid architecture imports still fail the required gates.

riverpod_lint.compatibility_reason: Riverpod lint is coupled to the Riverpod runtime/generator and analyzer/custom_lint APIs; changing it separately can create false negatives or invalid generated-code guidance.
riverpod_lint.exit_condition: Phase 58 reaffirms or upgrades riverpod_lint with the full Riverpod/analyzer cohort and proves representative invalid Riverpod usage still fails while the production tree remains clean.

import_guard_custom_lint.compatibility_reason: The Clean Architecture import boundary is enforced through this custom-lint plugin on analyzer 8.x; changing the plugin lane without proof could admit forbidden lower-layer dependencies.
import_guard_custom_lint.exit_condition: Phase 58 reaffirms or upgrades import_guard_custom_lint only after deliberately invalid imports fail both the architecture test and custom-lint gate on the selected analyzer graph.

sqlcipher_native.compatibility_reason: 0.7.0+eol ships no native SQLCipher library; the encrypted native path is proven only with sqlite3 2.x and the SQLCipher Pod strip.
sqlcipher_native.exit_condition: Phase 60 verifies a coordinated SQLCipher/native upgrade on iOS and Android without system SQLite fallback.

prohibitions: Do not use sqlite3_flutter_libs, plaintext SQLite, or a system-SQLite fallback.
Do not lower iOS 15, Android API 24, or the analyzer/import-boundary gate.
Do not change a dependency, lockfile, native declaration, or generated source while establishing this snapshot.
